source_snapshot.test_name_items: Event Logs Change Smbios Event Log Settings
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify SMBIOS Event Log policy defaults and persistence of approved non-default settings without erasing, filtering, disabling or misattributing required diagnostic evidence, and confirm the intended controlled event remains visible in the correct store.
original_method: Archive the distinct BIOS SMBIOS log, BMC SEL and OS logs, manually load defaults and compare named policy fields with SPEC, apply a bounded field matrix, save/reboot, verify persistence and controlled-event behavior, then restore the approved state.
manual_activity: An engineer must operate and visually accept BIOS SMBIOS Event Log policy fields and observe firmware log behavior. Automated log collection and correlation are supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS/BMC identity and SMBIOS Event Log implementation
Named enable/filter/erase-full/clear-related fields with SPEC defaults and exact semantics
Ownership/mapping among BIOS SMBIOS log, BMC SEL and OS logs
Approved non-destructive controlled event and expected record fields/timing
Pre-change archive, explicit clear authorization if any, console/OOB and final policy
safety_requirements: Archive every relevant log store before any setting change; do not clear evidence merely because the source preamble says clear logs.
Never operationalize all/random or invoke clear/erase actions without separate explicit approval and archive verification.
Do not substitute BMC SEL or OS logs for the BIOS SMBIOS log; correlate stores by timestamp, event source and ownership.
Use a non-destructive controlled event and avoid fault injection not separately approved.
Stop on unexpected evidence loss/filtering, store wrap, boot failure or management loss.
Restore the approved policy; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only full BIOS log exports where supported, BMC SEL and OS logs with timestamps, current policy metadata and boot/management health around operator phases.
Correlate the approved stimulus with exact record identifiers without clearing any store.
Do not drive BIOS, change policy, clear logs, inject faults or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve fields/defaults, store ownership, event stimulus, any clear operation and recovery.
Perform and capture default-first and bounded policy changes plus controlled-event observation.
Interpret cross-store evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; BMC SEL policy or OS logging configuration is not equivalent to BIOS SMBIOS Event Log policy.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the firmware method and add version-recorded, read-only separate-store export and timestamp/event-ID correlation; never auto-clear logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; the generic clear-logs preamble is constrained by evidence-preservation approval.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define each policy field's effect on storage, filtering, retention and full-log behavior; archive stores, create one approved event, and trace its exact representation across BIOS, BMC and OS without assuming equivalence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS/BMC logging implementation and event taxonomy.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, OS/kernel and log-decoder/export tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform SMBIOS Event Log policy and BMC event ownership documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random policy changes and blanket clearing with bounded field effects, evidence preservation and controlled-event correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves defaults/persistence and adds retention/filter/ownership/event visibility coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field semantics, stores, stimulus, record mapping and archive/clear policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Different stores may normalize timestamps or events; absence from one store is not failure unless ownership says it should appear.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve named policy fields and one event class. Results must state store, event and filter/retention exclusions and cannot claim all event logging.
expected_evidence: Platform identity, field/default/store matrix, archive hashes, approval and recovery
Complete pre-change BIOS/BMC/OS log baselines and current policy captures
Load Default captures plus SPEC and retention/visibility comparison
Non-default captures, persistence and controlled-event trace across owned stores
Approved final policy, preserved logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items explicitly requests changing log settings, and the persistence/default lifecycle is coherent. Exact fields and event mapping are readiness inputs, not contradictory facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The policy-setting intent is clear. Missing field/store/event details must gate execution but do not permanently block the master case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual firmware operation and adds forensic preservation and separate-store ownership safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its archive/event correlation while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates firmware acceptance from log collection and refuses blanket log clearing or cross-store substitution.

review_improvement: Prevents persistence testing from destroying the very diagnostic history needed to validate filtering, retention and event visibility.
independent_technical_reasoning: Core acceptance requires human BIOS policy configuration and visual verification. Automated log exports can corroborate effects but cannot perform that manual firmware work, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat policy changes, event stimuli, clears or reboots after evidence-loss, filtering, boot or management anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
